task_definition.task_description: Please check whether the NASDAQ market is open, then look up Apple’s current stock price and confirm the quote details. After that, estimate the trading cost for buying one share at that price on a VIP tier, then pull the latest business news and analyze this view: “AAPL remains attractive due to strong services growth and improving margins.”
